study type: Subgroup analysis of a prospective cohort study
outcome: Apgar score <7 at 5 minutes of life
cohort: 732 primigravid women eligible for normal vaginal delivery at 36 0/7 to 36 6/7 weeks of gestation
finding: Using MRI and ultrasound-based models to predict the gestational age at which birthweight would exceed 4000g may reduce macrosomia-related adverse outcomes in primigravid women, with the MRI-based model demonstrating better identification of high-risk patients.
mod_finding: Patients who delivered after the predicted gestational age by both the MRI and ultrasound models had a higher risk of cesarean delivery compared to those who delivered before the predicted gestational age.
gest_age: Median gestational age at birth was 39.86 weeks
